decisions.reason: Because this burner component draws directly on the firm's existing radiant-heater knowledge and service base, its high absorptive capacity makes improvement and continued use in the core business more likely than withdrawal.

As a flagship electric product line closely connected to the firm's heating expertise and strategic move toward broader low-carbon solutions, it is very likely to be retained and refined through in-house R&D.

The electric halogen infrared heater is related enough to the firm's established offer for learning and adaptation, but its less central strategic role makes it somewhat more exposed than the flagship lines.

This industrial electric infrared hall-heater line sits close to the firm's core application knowledge in large non-residential spaces, so early market feedback can be absorbed and used to improve rather than abandon it.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is both highly related to the firm's installed knowledge base and strongly aligned with its stated hydrogen-ready direction, making continued commercialization very likely.
